newsitem.title: FRANCE: Doomsday guru asked Turk to kill woman - French TV.
newsitem.headline: Doomsday guru asked Turk to kill woman - French TV.

text.p: The guru of a doomsday cult asked a Turkish man to kill a woman sect member in 1994, the man told French TF1 television on Tuesday, providing new evidence of grisly methods used by the Order of the Solar Temple.

Fifty-three cult members died in a macabre ritual in 1994 in Switzerland and Canada, including guru Luc Jouret. Another 16 charred corpses were found in the French Alps last December in a grisly murder-cum-suicide.

The Turkish man told TF1 he was friends with two French policemen, cult members who have been suspected of carrying out last year's killings before committing suicide. He said he went with them to see Jouret at a Paris hotel in June 1994.
"Jouret told me that they had an association and that in the group there was a woman. He told me "this woman has betrayed us and we're going to liquidate this woman'."
Asked to say if Jouret, a Belgian homeopathic doctor, then asked him to kill the woman, the man replied: "Yes". Asked how much he was offered, he said "two million francs" ($390,000).

The man, filmed only from behind to avoid identification, said he did not reply immediately but said one of the policemen repeated the question to him two weeks later. "The reply was negative. I didn't accept."
TF1 said the authorities were taking the Turkish man's statements seriously.
The man said he did not know who to contact about the murder offer, fearing he might be contacting friends of policemen Jean-Pierre Lardanchet and Patrick Rostan.
A Swiss magistrate probing the deaths of the 53 cult members said in April this year he believed all but 15 were murdered and that there was no evidence any killer or witness had survived.
Last year, a French state prosecutor said Lardanchet and Rostan probably killed the 14 others in the French ritual and then shot themselves.

TF1 said the authorities were trying to see if Lardanchet had accomplices in the police. It added that one theory was that Lardanchet was a mole planted in the cult by the French Interior Ministry and who got trapped. ($1=5.124 French Franc)
